name: base-wallet-guard
description: Read-only Base mainnet ERC-20 allowance scanner. Answers 'what can move this wallet's tokens right now' with live eth_call reads instead of an indexer, and reports the exposed balance behind each live approval.

tools.name: scan_approvals
tools.description: Live allowances for a Base wallet against a verified registry of routers, aggregators, lending markets and marketplaces, plus the balances behind them.

tools.name: check_allowance
tools.description: One allowance(owner, spender) read, for spenders outside the registry.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Price, payment address and verification method for the Pro licence.

requirements.network: outbound HTTPS to public Base RPC endpoints
requirements.packages: none — the server imports the site's own modules

limits: An approval granted to a contract the wallet never transacted with and that is not in the registry will not be listed. A full historical sweep needs an archive node, which no free public Base endpoint provides.
